meta.title: Contract Amendment: refused for a user without the Category Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and attempt to amend a live contract through Contract Amendment, observing refusal or absence.
Repeat the Contract Amendment attempt as a Category Manager and verify that the action is available and can be carried out.
Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is deliberately granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and attempt to amend a live contract through Contract Amendment, observing refusal or absence.; Repeat the Contract Amendment attempt as a Category Manager and verify that the action is available and can be carried out.; Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is deliberately granted to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Category Manager user and as a Category Manager on the specified Enterprise tenant, attempt Contract Amendment on a live contract in both sessions, and record whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the second

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to role-specific users or open and assert the Contract Amendment flow.
Confirm the tester's resulting screen has no application crash or server error after the role-comparison attempt.
